title: A Dead Star the Size of a City Spins 716 Times a Second

scenes.text: A star the size of a city spins 716 times a second.
It is a pulsar, the collapsed core of a star that died.
It squeezes more than the Sun's worth of stuff into a ball about a dozen kilometres wide.
Each full spin takes just 1.4 milliseconds.
Its surface moves at tens of thousands of kilometres every second.

description:
A pulsar called PSR J1748-2446ad spins 716 times every second, the fastest known.
It is a neutron star only about a dozen kilometres wide.
How fast is too fast for you?
first_comment: A pulsar spins 716 times a second. What's the fastest thing you've ever seen spin?
